goal: Make inspectSpecBinding's unpaired-path binding_missing fallback (runtime/kernel/spec_binding.ts, reached when non-empty active/archived scope_hint paths exist but never pair into exactly one binding) name the concrete unpaired paths instead of returning an empty missing array and a generic message, and make batch_plan.ts render that detail; remove the unreachable SPEC_BINDING_REASONS.binding_incomplete dead-code entry.

acceptance.assertion: inspectSpecBinding's final binding_missing return (reached when active and/or archived Spec paths exist in scope_hint but do not pair into exactly one binding) populates missing with the concrete unpaired active and/or archived paths; the genuinely-empty case (no active and no archived paths at all) is unchanged, since it has no path to name.

batch_plan.ts's specBindingReason renders the populated missing paths for every binding_missing case that has them, through the same shared rendering branch binding_incomplete already uses; the unreachable SPEC_BINDING_REASONS.binding_incomplete map entry is removed.
